notes: I rated from the supplied renders only (no browser). Scripts: scratchpad/fb/diff.py, reg.py. Side-by-side images: scratchpad/fb/sbs_*.png (w18 left, head right). I confirmed the pixel-diff summary: ra_door2floor 0 %, s06 4.9 %, the rest 20-76 %, head 1-16 levels darker and bluer. Every change traces to the lighting run (04_shaders/12_scene). The 07_shell geometry is untouched, and the seat/monument edits create no clashes with tubs, dado, door linings or the viewing window. Net effect on the shell: the panes are better (near-white, neutral), the PY/Y tub hue is better (matches py_37303), and the lining tone is closer to c_27316/py_37303. The F bowls and the grazing lining have gone cooler than the photos (fb-1, fb-2: lighting). There are no high issues and no shell medium issues, so the shell holds at 8.5, the same as w17/w18.
